# crisprFlow

The goal of crisprFlow is to provide wrappers and functions to
facilitate the analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 sequencing data - from raw sgRNA
sequencing reads to biological insights. The R package includes
functions for quality control assessment, guide RNA counting,
normalization, statistical analysis, and visualization of results.

Currently, the package requires installation of external tools (non
R-based) that are not automatically installed (*MAGeCK*,
*guide-counter*). A containerized version of the package is under
development to ease the installation process.

## Installation

You can install the development version of crisprFlow like so:

``` r

remotes::install_github("sigven/crisprFlow")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_fastq_files()`](check_fastq_files.md) : Check for expected
  FASTQ files in a directory
- [`clean_treatment_timepoint_label()`](clean_treatment_timepoint_label.md)
  : Function to clean treatment and timepoint labels from a data frame
  This function separates the 'label' column into 'treatment' and
  'timepoint' columns, removes any existing 'treatment' and 'timepoint'
  columns, and arranges the data frame by timepoint
- [`count_sgRNA_guidecounter()`](count_sgRNA_guidecounter.md) : Count
  sgRNA from FASTQ files using guide-counter
- [`count_sgRNA_guidecounter_fastq()`](count_sgRNA_guidecounter_fastq.md)
  : Count sgRNA from FASTQ files using guide-counter (alternative
  version)
- [`count_sgRNA_mageck()`](count_sgRNA_mageck.md) : Count sgRNA from
  FASTQ files using MAGECK
- [`count_sgRNA_mageck_fastq()`](count_sgRNA_mageck_fastq.md) : Count
  sgRNA from a single FASTQ file using MAGeCK
- [`detect_hits_drugz()`](detect_hits_drugz.md) : Run DrugZ for hit
  detection
- [`detect_hits_fpa()`](detect_hits_fpa.md) : Run FPA for hit detection
- [`detect_hits_mageck_mle()`](detect_hits_mageck_mle.md) : Run MAGeCK
  MLE for hit detection
- [`estimate_fold_change()`](estimate_fold_change.md) : Estimate log2
  fold change of sgRNA counts between arbitrary conditions
- [`exampleCountSummary`](exampleCountSummary.md) : Simulated CRISPR
  screen: count summary
- [`exampleCounts`](exampleCounts.md) : Simulated CRISPR screen: sgRNA
  counts
- [`exampleSampleMeta`](exampleSampleMeta.md) : Simulated CRISPR screen:
  sample table
- [`gini_index()`](gini_index.md) : Compute the Gini coefficient/index
  for a numeric vector x.
- [`gini_index2()`](gini_index2.md) : Compute the Gini coefficient/index
  for a numeric vector x.
- [`plot_fc_scatterplot()`](plot_fc_scatterplot.md) : Plot fold change
  scatterplot, drug vs. T0, control vs. T0
- [`plot_sgRNA_gini_index()`](plot_sgRNA_gini_index.md) : Plot sgRNA
  Gini index bar plot
- [`plot_sgRNA_histogram()`](plot_sgRNA_histogram.md) : Plot sgRNA count
  distribution histogram
- [`plot_sgRNA_mapping()`](plot_sgRNA_mapping.md) : Plot sgRNA mapping
  statistics bar plot
- [`plot_sgRNA_missing()`](plot_sgRNA_missing.md) : Plot sgRNA zero
  counts bar plot
- [`plot_sgRNA_pca()`](plot_sgRNA_pca.md) : Plot PCA of sgRNA count data
- [`qc_check_library_concordance()`](qc_check_library_concordance.md) :
  Check that the counted sgRNAs match the intended library
- [`qc_check_meta()`](qc_check_meta.md) : Check a sample table (and its
  match to a count matrix)
- [`qc_genes_with_lost_guides()`](qc_genes_with_lost_guides.md) : Genes
  that lost many of their sgRNAs
- [`qc_guide_representation()`](qc_guide_representation.md) : Detect
  sgRNAs at one or more reference stages
- [`qc_inputs`](qc_inputs.md) : Inputs shared by the QC functions
- [`qc_log2cpm()`](qc_log2cpm.md) : log2 CPM matrix of targeting sgRNAs
- [`qc_plot_control_guides()`](qc_plot_control_guides.md) : Plot control
  sgRNA abundance across samples
- [`qc_plot_control_read_proportion()`](qc_plot_control_read_proportion.md)
  : Plot the fraction of reads mapping to each negative-control group
- [`qc_plot_count_distribution()`](qc_plot_count_distribution.md) : Plot
  sgRNA count distributions
- [`qc_plot_guide_detection()`](qc_plot_guide_detection.md) : Plot
  detected and lost sgRNAs per stage
- [`qc_plot_pca()`](qc_plot_pca.md) : Plot a PCA of samples
- [`qc_plot_read_mapping()`](qc_plot_read_mapping.md) : Plot mapped and
  unmapped reads per sample
- [`qc_plot_replicate_correlation()`](qc_plot_replicate_correlation.md)
  : Plot sample-to-sample correlations
- [`qc_plot_replicate_scatter()`](qc_plot_replicate_scatter.md) :
  Within-group replicate scatter plots
- [`qc_plot_sample_metric()`](qc_plot_sample_metric.md) : Plot a
  per-sample metric
- [`qc_plot_sgrna_phenotype_distribution()`](qc_plot_sgrna_phenotype_distribution.md)
  : sgRNA-level phenotype distribution with per-gene strip chart
- [`qc_read_count_dir()`](qc_read_count_dir.md) : Read and merge
  per-sample count files
- [`qc_read_count_summary()`](qc_read_count_summary.md) : Read a count
  summary file
- [`qc_read_counts()`](qc_read_counts.md) : Read a merged count matrix
- [`qc_read_library()`](qc_read_library.md) : Read an sgRNA library
- [`qc_read_summary_dir()`](qc_read_summary_dir.md) : Read and combine
  per-sample count summaries
- [`qc_replicate_correlation_table()`](qc_replicate_correlation_table.md)
  : Within-group replicate correlations
- [`qc_sample_stats()`](qc_sample_stats.md) : Per-sample sgRNA count
  statistics
- [`read_sgRNA_counts()`](read_sgRNA_counts.md) : Read sgRNA count data
  from a MAGeCK/guide-counter count file
- [`read_sgRNA_counts2()`](read_sgRNA_counts2.md) : Read sgRNA count
  data from a MAGeCK/guide-counter count file and separate targeted
  sgRNAs and controls
- [`read_sgRNA_summary()`](read_sgRNA_summary.md) : Read sgRNA summary
  statistics from a MAGeCK/guide-counter summary file
